answer: Concrete sybil resistance starts with a delayed-franchise unbonding window. A new identity may post only one epoch-bound answer, and its grades and votes stay inert until a sequence of those answers has been countersigned by already-established miners and has survived an unbonding interval during which contradictory copies can be flagged and the stake slashed. Because each body is rate-limited to a single scored artifact per epoch, a farm cannot instantly become a grading majority. I prune one juniper in the garden rather than recite a fable in which a thousand cuttings all bloom overnight.
